periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation tilted approximately 45 degrees downward toward the snout relative to the facial horizontal.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a length significantly greater than the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering with the lowest point extending toward the ventral-anterior region of the cheek.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Relatively flat U-shape curvature along the posterior edge of the band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick band occupying approximately 30 percent of the longitudinal torso length visible from the lateral profile.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded convex apex on the visible right ear.

other_distinctive_markers: The typically white regions of the pelage on the torso and head exhibit a prominent yellowish-tan or cream-colored tint.
